title: Power Apps: display density settings for model-driven apps
summary: The app control path starts inside the app designer without explaining how to reach it from Power Apps. The prerequisite refresh path has the same navigation gap. The roadmap facts and documented density behaviour are supported, but licensing should distinguish existing app entitlements from unpublished density-specific terms.
